name: Delhi Pension Scheme To Women In Distress (Widow Pension)
benefit: The quantum of financial assistance under this scheme is ₹ 2,500/- per month.
_eligibility_text:
- A woman who is a widow, divorced, separated, abandoned, deserted, or destitute woman above the age of 18 years of lifelong.
- Residence of a minimum of 5 years in Delhi before the date of application. 
- The annual income of the applicant should be less than ₹ 1,00,000/-per annum from all sources (including rent, interest/dividends on savings & investments, earnings from the farm, property sale proceeds, etc.) of the applicant. 
- Applicant should have the Aadhar number 
- The Applicant should have a single-operated Aadhar-linked account with any bank in the NCT of Delhi only. 
- Must not be receiving any pension/ financial assistance from Central Govt./ State Govt./MCD or NDMC and other Governmental/local bodies or any other source for this purpose.
